title: OpenAI gates Astra's strongest cyber power to a select group only - TCR 09/02/26
description:
OpenAI said Astra is the first model rated at its "critical" cyber tier and scored a perfect 100 on ExploitBench, Anthropic shipped Claude Fable 5.1 generally available and says typical work costs roughly 25% less and long agent jobs can cost up to 45% less, depending on the workload, and China's installed solar hit 1.286 billion kilowatts to pass coal as its largest power source.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-september-2-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:49 OpenAI's Astra crosses the critical cyber threshold
4:24 Anthropic ships Fable 5.1 and gates its twin
7:37 China's installed solar passes coal
10:05 Tesla's hidden driver-assist crash data
12:48 ChatGPT Health reaches the patient record
16:05 Close

This episode covers OpenAI's Astra critical-tier cyber capability and the Daybreak Blue gate, Anthropic's Fable 5.1 and its gated Mythos 5.1 twin, China's solar-past-coal milestone, Tesla's redacted driver-assist crash filings confirmed by Electrek, and ChatGPT Health's Epic integration reaching 325 million patient records.

OpenAI rated Astra at the "critical" cybersecurity tier for the first time, able to independently find and chain unknown software exploits, and reports that it scored a perfect 100 on ExploitBench. In OpenAI's evaluation, it beat GPT-5.6 Sol and Anthropic's Mythos. The strongest version goes first to Cisco, Cloudflare, Palo Alto Networks, and government partners, though Z.ai plans to release GLM-5.3's full weights after a two-week delay, and independent research suggests that some open models can catch up to gated cyber systems within months. Anthropic ran the same play, releasing Fable 5.1 to everyone and saying typical work costs roughly 25 percent less while keeping the identically-capable Mythos 5.1 behind a trusted-access gate. China's installed solar passed coal at 1.286 billion kilowatts, with solar accounting for over 40 percent of new generating capacity even as compute demand climbs. Tesla's own recorders confirmed driver-assist was "verified engaged" when a Batavia passenger and a stopped Mesa driver died, while the software version, video, and telematics stay redacted. And OpenAI connected ChatGPT Health to Epic at 325-million-patient scale, read-only by design, handing a small clinic the synthesis capacity a specialist team used to provide.
